name: image-edit
description: Edit an existing image from a text instruction (image-to-image) through a configured API-key provider or the connected ChatGPT account. The result shows directly in the chat.

configSchema.label: Provider
configSchema.hint: Which configured provider renders the edits: an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (its key and base URL are reused) or the connected ChatGPT account. Add providers in Settings → Brain.

configSchema.label: Model
configSchema.hint: Image model of the chosen provider. The picker offers the models enabled for that provider in Settings → Models; enable one there first. Empty uses the provider's default.
